governingPrinciple: Compliance before implementation. Standards before abstractions. Authoritative vehicle data before vehicle-specific claims. Deterministic logic before AI explanation.

authorities.title: Electric-powered Vehicles: Electric Powertrain Integrity
authorities.scope: Electric-powered vehicle electrical safety and propulsion battery safety. Not a generic authority for every 12-volt conventional charging-system instructional claim.
authorities.notes: Applicability must be evaluated against the regulated vehicle/system and effective/compliance dates before a rule is asserted.

authorities.title: Kansas Consumer Protection Act
authorities.scope: Consumer transactions, deceptive practices, warranties, and related supplier conduct. This is a state compliance overlay, not an electrical circuit design specification.
authorities.notes: Technical automotive requirements must not be inferred from the KCPA. Use it only for claims within its actual consumer-protection scope.

authorities.title: Road vehicles — Environmental conditions and testing for electrical and electronic equipment — Part 1: General
authorities.scope: General terminology and requirements for environmental conditions/testing of road-vehicle electrical and electronic systems/components within the standard's stated scope.
authorities.notes: Store identifier, edition, applicability, and licensed clause locators only unless project licensing permits standard text reuse.

authorities.title: Road vehicles — Environmental conditions and testing for electrical and electronic equipment — Part 2: Electrical loads
authorities.scope: Electrical loads and related testing for road-vehicle electrical/electronic systems and components within the standard's stated scope.
authorities.notes: Do not convert this standard into a legal requirement unless a governing authority, contract, certification scheme, or other binding instrument makes it applicable.

authorities.title: Electrically propelled road vehicles — Safety specifications — Part 2: Vehicle operational safety
authorities.scope: Operational safety requirements specific to electrically propelled road vehicles within the standard's stated scope.
authorities.notes: The ISO abstract states that this document does not provide comprehensive safety information for manufacturing, maintenance, and repair personnel.
